record.context_brief: all tangent-cone Betti numbers under interval completion
record.original_question: Let Gamma be a numerical semigroup, let Gamma_tilde be its interval completion, and let G_Gamma = gr(k[[Gamma]]) and G_{Gamma_tilde} = gr(k[[Gamma_tilde]]) be the associated graded rings. Is it true for every homological degree i that b_i(G_Gamma) <= b_i(G_{Gamma_tilde})?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be a numerical semigroup, that is, a cofinite submonoid of $(\mathbb{N},+)$ containing $0$. Write $\Gamma = \{0 = \gamma_0 < \gamma_1 < \gamma_2 < \cdots\}$ with multiplicity $m = \gamma_1$. The interval completion of $\Gamma$ is the numerical semigroup
$$\widetilde{\Gamma} = \Gamma \cup \{n \in \mathbb{N} : n \geq m\},$$
i.e.\ the numerical semigroup obtained from $\Gamma$ by adjoining every integer that is at least the multiplicity. Fix a field $k$, and let $k[[\Gamma]] \subseteq k[[t]]$ denote the semigroup ring $k[[t^\gamma : \gamma \in \Gamma]]$. Let
$$G_\Gamma = \mathrm{gr}_{\mathfrak{m}}(k[[\Gamma]]) = \bigoplus_{n\geq 0} \mathfrak{m}^n/\mathfrak{m}^{n+1}$$
be the associated graded ring of $k[[\Gamma]]$ with respect to its maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$ (the tangent cone of the monomial curve singularity defined by $\Gamma$); analogously define $G_{\widetilde{\Gamma}}$. For a graded $k$-algebra $R$ with residue field $k$, let
$$b_i(R) = \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}_i^R(k,k)$$
denote its $i$-th Betti number (equivalently, the $i$-th total Betti number of the minimal graded free resolution of $k$ over $R$, or, by duality, the number of generators in homological degree $i$ of the minimal free resolution of $k$ over its associated polynomial-ring presentation).

Prove or disprove: for every numerical semigroup $\Gamma$ and every integer $i \geq 0$,
$$b_i(G_\Gamma) \leq b_i(G_{\widetilde{\Gamma}}).$$
artifact.category_tag: Numerical semigroup rings and tangent cones
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent (2024) collection of open problems on relations of numerical semigroups. Web searches did not surface any subsequent paper claiming a proof or counterexample to the inequality $b_i(G_\Gamma) \le b_i(G_{\widetilde{\Gamma}})$ for all $i$. Related work computes Betti numbers of tangent cones for special families (pseudo-symmetric, concatenated arithmetic sequences) but does not resolve this comparison in general.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on numerical semigroups (arXiv:2406.00790)
status_evidence.snippet: We collect some open problems about minimal presentations of numerical semigroups and, more generally, about defining ideals and free resolutions of their semigroup rings and associated graded rings.
status_evidence.claim: The problem appears in a 2024 collection of open problems and is stated as unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Tangent Cones of Concatenated Numerical Semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: studies the tangent cone at the origin and the Hilbert series for a family of numerical semigroups generated by concatenation of arithmetic sequences
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work computes Betti numbers of tangent cones in special families but does not address the interval-completion comparison.
